## Featured Production & PoC Systems

### 1. Conversational AI Assistant for a Streaming Platform (Production) — Searce
- **Role**: AI Engineer
- **Stack**: Python, LangGraph, LangChain, Gemini 2.0 Flash, Vertex AI Search (Discovery Engine), BigQuery, Pydantic v2, DeepEval, FastAPI, GCP
- **Architecture**: Linear EPG sub-agent within a LangGraph supervisor graph with cyclic START-to-EPG-to-TOOLS topology and Pydantic v2 self-repair retry loops resolving schedules across 121 live channels.
- **Key Outcomes**: 45% reduction in schedule query latency via Vertex AI Search (44K+ daily records); deterministic SGT (UTC+8) temporal grounding resolving 95%+ relative-time queries; 100% elimination of live-match false positives via regex boundary tokenizers; zero regressions benchmarked with DeepEval (GEval).

### 2. Multi-Agent Financial Guidance Platform (PoC) — Cloudside
- **Role**: AI Engineer
- **Stack**: Python, Google ADK, Vertex AI, Gemini, Vector Search, BigQuery, Cloud Functions, LangChain, Pydantic, BeautifulSoup
- **Architecture**: End-to-end GOV.UK ingestion crawler with depth-limited domain scoping, 3072-dimensional `gemini-embedding-001` vectors, chunk-expansion retriever resolving top-k hits to full parent pages, and Agent Engine post-conversation PII masking auditor.

### 3. Gong → Salesforce Agentic ETL Pipeline (PoC) — Cloudside
- **Role**: AI Engineer
- **Stack**: Python, Google ADK SequentialAgent, GCP Cloud Functions, FastAPI, Gemini 2.0 Flash, Salesforce REST API, JWT
- **Architecture**: 3-stage agentic ETL pipeline converting unstructured sales calls into structured MEDDPICC opportunity fields; OAuth 2.0 JWT Bearer RS256 authentication and OIDC ID tokens.

### 4. Dual RAG Chatbots over Documentation and Source Code (PoC) — Cloudside
- **Role**: AI Engineer
- **Stack**: Python, Vertex AI Matching Engine, Scrapy, BeautifulSoup, Firestore, LangChain, Cloud Functions, Gemini
- **Architecture**: Version-restricted namespace indexing over automotive middleware docs and C++/Python source code; cost-tier model cascade (Gemini 1.5 Flash rewrite + Gemini 2.0 Flash synthesis).

### 5. Figma-to-React Native Code Generator (Internal PoC) — Cloudside
- **Role**: AI Engineer
- **Stack**: Python, Gemini 2.5 Pro, Figma REST API, Streamlit, React Native
- **Architecture**: Hierarchical schema extractor and multimodal prompting demuxing model responses into multi-file components and screens.
